solution.notes: Must be a closed triangle. Weight (W) acts vertically down. Normal (R) perpendicular to slope. Friction (Fr) parallel to slope upwards.

Q5.oracle_insight: Common Mistake: Students often draw the Normal Reaction (R) vertically upwards on a slope. Remember: 'Normal' means Perpendicular (90°) to the surface.

Q11.oracle_insight: Pressure vs Force: A steamroller needs High Pressure ($P=F/A$). While wide tires reduce pressure (bad for compacting), a heavy drum increases Force (good for compacting).
